case_title: Shraddha Gupta v. The State of Uttar Pradesh and Others
statutory_provisions: Uttar Pradesh Gangster and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986 ss. 2 & 3; IPC s. 147, 304, 504, 323, 506, 120-B
neutral_facts: The accused, Shraddha Gupta, was involved in a case where her sister, Sadhna Sharma, was killed. The incident occurred when her sister was returning from Badaun to Ujhani on a scooter. A car driven by the accused followed her and rammed into her scooter, causing her to fall. The accused then shouted at the driver to kill the victim. The victim died in the hospital. The accused was later implicated in the case through further investigation and was charged under the Gangsters Act, 1986. The case involved multiple accused, including the appellant, who were alleged to be part of a gang involved in anti-social activities. The accused were charged with various offenses under the Indian Penal Code and the Gangsters Act, 1986.
